question: Does actual measured motion improve current-contact family inference beyond the existing observer/geometry locator at saved states?
scope: Offline shadow evaluation only. No new Gazebo physics, live command compensation, observer replacement, controller reset or default change.
source_campaign: I-58 native B: Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight, 44 seconds, initial shaft -1/+0.3/+0.9 rad, yaw45 degrees, native LQR/observer/feedforward and 120ms preparation, caps1.5/.6/.6Nm/.3/.3m/s
sampling: Every original timestamp, 8801 per case, 26403 total; no downsampling. Terminal state is recorded but its new command was not held.
candidate_normal_hint: intrinsic_normal(observer_force, observer_moment, radius), as in native SupportLocator; the filtered terrain normal is context only
candidate_domain_qualification: Velocity ranking is conditioned on an observer-derived normal search domain, so this is not an independent replacement for the momentum observer.

candidate_search.rim_family_mapping: rim_A -> shell_A; rim_B -> shell_B. No general multi-contact decomposition is implemented.
candidate_search.geometry_rule: Project each seed onto physically valid spherical patch bands or exposed rim circles, then retain only candidates within the fixed normal cone. Never relabel an invalid point onto another patch.

velocity_residual: Tangential material-point velocity for each candidate from measured body/joint motion plus previous-held ideal belt surface velocity; stationary ground and rolling-without-slip hypothesis.
wrench_residual: Observed moment about wheel centre minus candidate_lever cross observed_force, divided by R*max(norm(force),1N); single resultant-force model, not friction-constrained multi-contact force recovery.

scores.fused: geometry + wrench residual term + velocity residual term

family_score: Minimum complete score over valid candidates within each family; do not minimize components separately at different points. Margins compare different families, never duplicate points.
score_interpretation: Uncalibrated ranking costs and engineering thresholds; no posterior probability, motor-current measurement or force-sensor claim.
excitation_m_s: norm(body translation velocity) + R*norm(body angular velocity) + R*norm(three measured joint rates) + norm(two prior-held belt speeds); motion-availability screen only

confidence.singleton_rule: Keep raw geometry-forced ranking but never count a singleton as velocity-confident.
confidence.unknown_rule: Invalid input/load, absent candidates, insufficient motion/contrast, low score margin or high residual produce unknown accepted label. Preserve raw rank and individual abstention reasons.
confidence.application: Same confidence controls applied to all four methods for matched comparisons. No temporal smoothing/hysteresis is introduced in this first experiment.

evaluation.truth_source: Exact precision.npz truth_patch_loads_N and truth_time_s, opened for scoring only after feature/score outputs and manifests have been sealed.
evaluation.clock: Truth describes last completed1ms physics step at the saved state; observer wrench represents a filtered preceding5ms interval. This is a sampled-clock comparison, not a computation-delay measurement.
evaluation.primary_denominator: ALL truth-eligible primary-window single-support states; no-candidate and wrong-singleton count as raw rank failures. Do not score only states where truth is in candidate bank.
evaluation.native_reference: Dominant exact_estimated_support_loads_N family; missing or tied dominant label is unknown and counts as error on truth-eligible states.
evaluation.multi_contact: Truth-ambiguous/dual-support states reported separately, including counts and candidate coverage, without forced unique-label accuracy or multi-contact recovery claims.
evaluation.stable_secondary: Report subset where eligible truth family is unchanged throughout preceding/following10ms; future labels are evaluator-only, never features.
evaluation.false_switch: Adjacent primary-window states that are both truth-eligible with the same true family, but raw inferred labels change; include unknown-to-valid changes. Report each phase separately.
evaluation.timing: Descriptive only, using true family changes with at least25ms stable eligible family on both sides, compare inferred label onset within100ms; preserve missing/early/late events, no selected favorable shift.

gates.confidence_denominator: Primary truth-eligible states with >=2 valid candidate families and excitation>=.02m/s. Separately report coverage over ALL primary truth-eligible and all motion-eligible states.
gates.empty_denominator: Unscorable gate is not a pass.
gates.interpretation: All fixed shadow gates are required to recommend a later controlled integration experiment. Passing does not establish physical tracking improvement or authorize automatic integration. No post-result retuning.

required_controls: private kinematics only; no controller/physics step/contact queries
singletons and no-candidate not false confidence
required_outputs: per-case candidate coverage and raw/confident label metrics
explicit zero physics and no live compensation
